title: HB 189 (2015-2016 (131th General Assembly)): H. B. No. 189: Requires photo identification to vote
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) and provide proof of the elector's identity in the form of a photo identification.
(section) 3501.01(AA)
(quote) (3) It is one of the following documents: (a) An Ohio driver's license or Ohio commercial driver's license issued by the registrar of motor vehicles or a deputy registrar under Chapter 4507. of the Revised Code that shows the current or former address of the elector, regardless of whether that address conforms to the address in the individual's voter registration record and regardless of whether the license is expired; (b) A state identification card issued by the registrar of motor vehicles or a deputy registrar under section 4507.50 of the Revised Code that shows the current or former address of the elector, regardless of whether that address conforms to the address in the individual's voter registration record, and that is not expired or that expired after the date of the most recent general election;
(section) 3501.01(AA)
(quote) (c) A United States military identification card that is not expired or that expired after the date of the most recent general election; or (d) A United States passport that is not expired or that expired after the date of the most recent general election.
(section) 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) STRUCK: , a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document, other than a notice of voter registration mailed by a board of elections under section 3503.19 of the Revised Code, that shows the name and current address of the elector
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) 3505.18(A)(2)
(quote) has a religious objection to being photographed, the elector may execute an affirmation under penalty of election falsification to that effect. Upon signing the affirmation, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(section) 3505.18(A)(3)
(quote) (3) If an elector does not have or declines to provide photo identification to the precinct election officials but the elector does not have a religious objection to being photographed, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(section) 3505.181(B)(7)(a)
(quote) For a provisional ballot cast by an individual who does not provide identification to the election officials or execute an affirmation under division (B)(6) of this section to be eligible to be counted, the individual who cast that ballot, within seven days after the day of the election, shall do either of the following:
(section) 3505.181(B)(7)(a)(i)
(quote) (i) Provide to the board of elections proof of the individual's identity in the form of a photo identification, the individual's driver's license number, state identification card number, or the last four digits of the individual's social security number;
(section) 3505.181(B)(7)(a)(ii)
(quote) (ii) Execute an affirmation as permitted under division (A)(2) of section 3505.18 of the Revised Code, stating that the individual has a religious objection to being photographed.
(section) 4507.50(C)(1)
(quote) (C)(1) An individual may apply to the registrar or a deputy registrar for the issuance to that individual of an identification card or a temporary identification card under this section without payment of any fee if both of the following are true: (a) The individual cannot afford to pay the fees prescribed in division (A) of this section, including any lamination fee; (b) The individual's income does not exceed one hundred per cent of the federal poverty guidelines.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) 3509.03(E)
(quote) (1) The elector's photo identification, if the elector will be marking the absent voter's ballots in person at the office of the board of elections; or (2) If the elector will not be marking the ballots in person at the office of the board, one of the following: (a) The elector's driver's license or state identification card number; (b) The last four digits of the elector's social security number; (c) A copy of the elector's photo identification.
(section) 3509.05(A)
(quote) If the elector is marking the absent voter's ballots in person at the office of the board of elections, the elector shall provide photo identification to the election officials, or the elector may execute an affirmation under division (A)(2) of section 3505.18 of the Revised Code stating that the elector has a religious objection to being photographed and cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(section) 3509.05(A)
(quote) If the elector is not marking the absent voter's ballots in person at the office of the board, the elector shall provide the elector's driver's license or state identification card number or the last four digits of the elector's social security number on the statement of voter on the identification envelope, or shall include in the return envelope with the identification envelope a copy of the elector's photo identification.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) 3501.01(AA)(1)
(quote) (1) It contains the name of the elector, which shall conform to the name in the individual's voter registration record;
(other) 3501.01(AA): redefines 'photo identification' (document must contain the elector's name matching the voter registration record and a photograph, and must be an Ohio driver's license, state ID card, U.S. military ID card or U.S. passport); drops the current-address and expiration-date requirements for the license and ID card
(other) 3503.14, 3503.16, 3503.19, 3503.28: registration, change-of-address and voter-notice wording conformed to the new ID rule (read from the title and section list)
(other) 3505.18(B): the voter 'confirms' name and address by signing (not by writing) in the poll book; an attorney in fact may sign under 3501.382
(other) 3505.181-3505.183: provisional ballot rules, with the cure window and affirmation changed (seven days kept in this text)
(other) 3511.02, 3511.05, 3511.09: armed-service and overseas absentee ballot ID wording conformed
(other) 4507.50, 4507.52: free state ID card for an applicant who cannot pay and whose income is at or below the federal poverty guideline, on an affirmation under penalty of election falsification
(other) note: Only one version (introduced), with struck and new words marked. Quotes are the new words, or STRUCK where noted. The in-person rule has no option for current utility bills, bank statements, paychecks or other government documents; those are struck. The bill's bill page shows only introduction and referral to committee; no roll call.
